anchors: compare what the runner COLLECTS with the test files on disk
decision: Before scoring the Testing dimension, compare the files pytest collects tests from with the test files on disk and report every file that collected nothing; the aspect checklist's Tests row points back at it.

evidence.text: Scratch project: python_files = ["tests/**/test_*.py"] collected tests/sub/test_deep.py but not tests/test_top.py; the shipped block printed tests/test_top.py, printed nothing for the control pattern, listed every file when zero were collected (rc 5) and refused on a collection error (rc 2).

reopen_if: pytest matches a python_files pattern containing a separator against the basename, or the suite's runner reports files on disk that collected nothing on its own.
why: A pytest python_files pattern with a path in it is matched against the whole path and skips every test file directly in tests/, so a green run at high coverage hides whole files that never run, and repeated review sweeps scored such a suite without noticing.

anchors: can settle that batch but never ends the loop
decision: A fix-range sweep (only the last fix batch reviewed) can settle that batch but never ends the loop; after a clean fix-range sweep the next sweep is a full one. The severity table carries a full / fix-range column and the workflow diagram branches on it.

evidence.text: Quote-back: an opus arm on the pre-edit text found no column and could only derive the case from two rules; opus and haiku arms on the edited text quoted the new sentence and header.

reopen_if: The exit condition stops requiring a full sweep, or fix-range sweeps are dropped from the loop.
why: The exit rule required a full sweep but the table and diagram did not show which sweeps were full, so a session paraphrased the exit as 're-score after a clean sweep' after fix-range sweeps.

anchors: Each re-sweep dispatches its reviewers the way Step 3 does
decision: Step 7 states that each re-sweep dispatches its reviewers as Step 3 does, model opus AND effort medium pinned per dispatch, with the synthesis pass keeping its own Step 3 effort.

evidence.text: Quote-back: pre-edit Step 7 answered NONE for the re-sweep dispatch shape; opus and haiku arms on the edited text quoted the new sentence.

reopen_if: Review dispatches stop being pinned to opus at effort medium in bitranox:process-agents-subagent-driven-development.
why: A session running many sweeps dispatches reviewers from the outer loop and does not re-read Step 3, so a full sweep ran on model opus with effort unset.
